tracking.title: Set up tracking codes
tracking.description: bpost tracking needs no account — just the postal code parcels are delivered to. It becomes the default for every parcel you add to this hub. Add another hub for a different postal code.

data_description.postal_code: The delivery postal code — bpost requires it to look up a parcel.

account.title: Set up bpost account
account.description: Sign in once to import parcels from your My bpost account. Your password is never stored.

reauth_confirm.title: bpost sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description: bpost no longer accepts the stored tokens for {email}. Enter that account's password again.

error.invalid_auth: Unable to sign in with these credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the bpost account service.

abort.already_configured: A bpost hub for this postal code is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That sign-in is for a different bpost account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up for.

data_description.tracking_codes: The bpost tracking code(s), as printed on the shipping confirmation or the missed-delivery card. Uses this hub's postal code.

error.invalid_tracking_code: Enter at least one tracking code.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its bpost tracking code.

postal_code.name: Postal code
postal_code.description: Which bpost hub to add it to, if more than one is set up. Omit it when only one hub exists.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its bpost tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The bpost tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
